acceptanceCriteria.requirement: Capability identifiers are exact, case-sensitive and unique within the exact Factory release.
Contract identity is the exact opaque absolute URI plus independent opaque contract version; no dereference or publisher URI normalization occurs.
Inputs and outputs use Draft 2020-12 schema resources with top-level object payloads.
Error codes use the normative machine-readable grammar, are case-sensitive and unique within one contract; optional error schemas are Draft 2020-12 object schemas.
Guarantees are interpreted only when defined by a governed profile; no guarantee is inferred from omission or interaction mode.
Sync, async, streaming and event examples validate without prescribing a transport protocol.
The normative model reserves stable semantic diagnostics and vectors for PSI-43 without claiming the validator is already implemented.
The model preserves the four-product boundary and does not change reportVersion 1.0.
